Subject: New vendor: request for purchase reference and spend cap

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking our onboarding request. We (Arcadia Systems) are starting integration work next week and need a purchase/reference number so our finance team can attach the Redwood estimate to our PO. Quick background: we'll be provisioning dedicated testing capacity (n1-small) and an initial 3-month pilot with an anticipated spend of $18k.

Specifically we need: 
- A reference/PO number to include on our PO document
- Any spend cap / initial limit you recommend while we ramp (internal approval needs it)
- A template onboarding form PDF we should return with our legal contact info

I've attached our vendor setup spreadsheet (column draft) and the contact for our procurement lead. Can you confirm timelines to issue the reference?

Thanks,

Arcadia Systems

Hi Anna — great to meet you over email. Welcome!

We can issue a Redwood purchase reference (internal PO token) quickly. To speed things up, please: 
1) Fill and return the attached onboarding form (Arcadia_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf).
2) Confirm the initial spend cap you want Redwood to enforce while you ramp (you suggested ~$18k — do you want that as the cap or should we set a conservative $12k hold and raise after usage review?).
3) Provide final SKU/line-item mapping for the services you expect (GPU hours, priority throughput, storage). If you don't have a finalized list, we can accept the draft and then amend line items once you send the itemized breakdown.

I'll loop in Kimberly from Procurement to assign the purchase reference and confirm the spend cap workflow. Expect a follow-up from us by EOD Monday.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Ben —

Looping you two in. Arcadia has returned a partial vendor draft but their line-item SKU mapping is messy (they split burst capacity and sustained throughput differently). I started a nominal allocation so they can onboard testing, but we need to: 
- Pick a canonical SKU map and agree on the spend cap enforcement point in the billing system
- Issue a purchase reference token that their procurement team can put on the external PO
- Note any temporary line-item corrections in ledger (they likely need merges of two burst SKUs into one unified throughput SKU)

If you both sign off I'll assign PO token RI-7421 and send final confirmation to Arcadia.

Thanks — Neha
